diagnostic_proposed.ownership: worker-local counters and per-scope unique set; merge after search; these structures never enter uninstrumented binary
diagnostic_proposed.limitations: Counts explain observed sequence locality and hypothetical saved calculations; no lookup-nanosecond, matcher-speed or accuracy conclusion; no subset/policy tuning from diagnostic results

Reverse rotated order when (image_index+floor(round/5)+phase_parity)%2==1, with phase_parity cold0/warm1/measured0. Measured round uses0..14, so each case occupies each order position exactly3 times per image; verify this before measurement and in raw CSV audit

benchmark_proposed.output_check: retain allfive cold outputs until cold round ends, take its exactV11 output as oracle and compare allfive outside timers, so no uncounted oracle call is added. Every warm/measured complete ordered vector compared with that separately compiled exactV11 oracle outside internal/adapter timers; no diagnostic counters in binary
benchmark_proposed.summary: retain all cold/warm/measured samples and regressions; per-image15 paired ratios then median, equal-weight image median/geomean, descriptive quantiles only; no ratio-of-absolute-medians substitution
